asr.full_text: Grow your Bitcoin with Meritrading International Introducing the Meritrading International Company Meritrading International Pty Ltd is a registered company in the Republic of South Africa. The registered office is situated at 341 Baers Nordea Dr in Northcliffe, South Africa. Johann Steenbich is a CEO and Founder from Polokwani in South Africa. The Attorneys and Legal Advisors of Mirror Trading International are Hesling Koenig who have their offices in Randberg, Johannesburg. The objective of Mirror Trading International is to grow your Bitcoin. Your balance in trade is always in Bitcoin and you earn Bitcoin daily When the price of Bitcoin rises the value of your trading account will go up. Mirror Trading International has a sustainable business model, trading forex using advanced inteligent software with Bitcoin as the base currency. The profitability of Mirror Trading International comes solely from the trading activites. Your full investment goes into your trading accounts. Mirutrading international provides you with a passive income opportunity. Earn passively from daily trading which takes place from Monday to Friday. The trade results are not guaranteed. No trading knowledge is required. To get started you will need a Bitcoin wallet, to register with Mirutrading international and $100 in Bitcoin, which is the To get started you will need a bitcoin wallet to register with Mirror Trading International and 100 dollars in bitcoin which is the suggested minimum. You will need to fund your account within 7 days. Accounts not funded will be deleted from the system after 7 days. In Mirror Trading International there are no membership fees, no subscriptions, no packages, no costs, no deductions. Your full Bitcoin payment goes to your trading account. There are no contracts or lockdowns. You can withdraw in full or partial amounts, and you can withdraw whenever you'd like, there are no withdrawal fees or penalties. Withdrawal requests will be sent to your Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours, as long as it's not over a weekend because then it might take a bit longer. Withdrawal requests will be sent to your Bitcoin Wallet within 48 hours – as long as it's not over a weekend, because then it might take a bit longer. Profits from successful daily trades are divided and allocated as follows, 40% to you the member, 30% to the trading system, 10% to MirrorTrading International for administration and to pay the referral bonuses and 20% to the binary profit-sharing bonuses. All income is subject to positive daily trading results. The system is fully automated and you can sit back and relax and receive your daily statements detailing the income from the trades for the day. Your daily trading income is automatically compounded. Members are not permitted their own broker accounts as per the terms of the Software License Agreement. Your account remains active, provided you maintain a minimum balance in trade. The suggested amount is $100 in Bitcoin. Providing you with passive, sustainable income from your bitcoin in trade, is at the very heart of MIRROR Trading International. That summarises the passive part of the opportunity, and as a member you will earn from the daily trading activities, and grow your Bitcoin. MIRROR Trading International has an optional, affiliate program should you wish to referrals friends or new members. The Affiliate Program Mirror Trading International offers two type of affiliate rewards 10% direct referral bonus or 20% weekly profit sharing bonus. This is the residual income opportunity all bonuses come from daily trading income and are therefore financially sustainable. You will earn a 10% referral bonus for every member you personally introduce to Meru Trading International and for any amounts they add over and above their original investment. Free members or people who have not funded their accounts do not quantify to earn 10% DEB bonuses. Twenty percent of daily income results are allocated to small customers Members or people who have not funded their accounts do not qualify to earn 10% direct referral bonuses. 20% of daily income results are allocated to the weekly Binary Profit Sharing Pool. The binary structure works as follows. You can recruit new members into your left or right leg. To qualify for binary bonuses, you will also need a minimum amount of $200 in the Trading Pool and you will need to have personally recruited one new member in your left and one in your right leg. The third person you personally introduce, will become spillover for one of the people you introduced before, as you can only place in your left or right side. Spillover will also occur if your sponsor or team members above you introduce people into a leg. 20% of the income from the week's trading will be shared according to the Bitcoin value of your weaker leg. When you are binary qualified with $200 to $999 in your personal account, this will allow you to earn up to 10 levels in the binary. As your team grows you can increase your amount in trade so that you can qualify to earn on more levels. With a thousand dollars to four thousand nine hundred and ninety nine dollars in the pool, you'll receive bonuses up to 20 levels deep. Accounts with five thousand dollars to nine thousand nine hundred and ninety nine dollars will receive bonuses up to 30 levels deep. And with ten thousand dollars and above, you'll receive bonuses up to 30 levels deep. And with $10,000 and above, you will receive bonuses on infinite levels of the binary structure in your weakest leg. Binary bonuses are paid every week on the Bitcoin value in your weaker leg, creating your weekly residual income. All referral and binary bonuses are subject to a seven day waiting period. There is a Maximum Binary Cap of $15,000$ per day and $75,000$ per week. Merit Trading International is a real company and if there are no trading profits there can be no income or bonuses. Merit Trading International is the opportunity we have all been looking for. Join us today, build your business and begin the journey to financial freedom.

textual.observation: The presentation describes depositing a suggested minimum of $100 in Bitcoin into a trading account in order to start, alongside a stated daily Bitcoin earning opportunity.

evidence.quote: Mirutrading international provides you with a passive income opportunity. Earn passively from daily trading which takes place from Monday to Friday.

To get started you will need a bitcoin wallet to register with Mirror Trading International and 100 dollars in bitcoin which is the suggested minimum. You will need to fund your account within 7 days.

textual.context: The ASR presents this as an opportunity offered by Mirror Trading International; it also states that trade results are not guaranteed.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed passive daily Bitcoin income opportunity is linked to registering, having a Bitcoin wallet, and funding an account with a suggested $100 in Bitcoin within seven days.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether an account was opened, funds were transferred, returns occurred, or whether the stated terms were available or performed as described.

textual.observation: The presentation offers a 10% referral bonus for personally introducing members, including amounts those members add above their original investment.

evidence.quote: You will earn a 10% referral bonus for every member you personally introduce to Meru Trading International and for any amounts they add over and above their original investment.
Free members or people who have not funded their accounts do not quantify to earn 10% DEB bonuses.

textual.context: The ASR describes this as an optional affiliate program and attributes the bonus offer to Mirror Trading International.
textual.potential_relevance: The stated 10% reward is tied to recruiting personally introduced members and to those members funding or adding to their investment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish that anyone was recruited, funded an account, received a bonus, or that the stated affiliate terms were implemented.

textual.observation: The presentation describes weekly binary profit-sharing bonuses conditioned on maintaining $200 in a trading pool and personally recruiting one member into each of two legs; it also states that higher balances qualify for more bonus levels, including infinite levels at $10,000 and above.

evidence.quote: To qualify for binary bonuses, you will also need a minimum amount of $200 in the Trading Pool and you will need to have personally recruited one new member in your left and one in your right leg.
And with $10,000 and above, you will receive bonuses on infinite levels of the binary structure in your weakest leg.
Binary bonuses are paid every week on the Bitcoin value in your weaker leg, creating your weekly residual income.

textual.context: The ASR presents the binary arrangement as part of the affiliate opportunity and says that referral and binary bonuses have a seven-day waiting period.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed weekly residual-income bonus is expressly linked to both maintaining a Bitcoin-denominated balance and recruiting participants into a two-leg structure, with stated rewards expanding at higher balances.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual recruitment, payments, account balances, bonus receipts, or the operation of the described binary structure.

visual.observation: Slides branded "Mirror Trading International" state an objective to "GROW YOUR BITCOIN," say a full investment/Bitcoin payment goes to trade, and display a daily trade-income allocation totaling 0.9680% for 4 November 2019.
visual.context: Promotional presentation for a trading-related program. The daily-income slide visibly qualifies that historical results are not a guarantee of future results.
visual.potential_relevance: The presentation links Bitcoin investment/payment to trading and shows a quantified daily trade-income result, which is a return-related claim connected to an asset contribution.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show an actual payment, account setup, transaction outcome, applicable terms beyond the displayed slides, or whether the stated result is representative.

visual.observation: Slides advertise an optional affiliate program, state that members earn "10% Direct Referral Bonuses," and depict a left-leg/right-leg "spillover" arrangement for personally introduced people.
visual.context: Promotional presentation; the affiliate program is explicitly described as optional.
visual.potential_relevance: A stated 10% referral bonus is linked to referring friends or new members, and the visual describes a multi-leg participant-placement structure.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show the full compensation terms, actual referrals, any payments, or whether participants receive bonuses.

visual.observation: A slide says to increase the amount in trade to qualify to earn on more binary levels, lists higher trade-amount tiers with more levels, and notes qualification is subject to required team members in the weaker leg; another slide says binary bonuses are paid weekly based on Bitcoin value in the weaker leg.
visual.context: Promotional presentation describing stated binary-bonus conditions.
visual.potential_relevance: The stated weekly residual-income bonus is tied both to increasing the amount in trade and to team-member/leg qualification conditions.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish the full calculation, whether the qualifications are met by anyone, or whether any bonus is paid.

visual.observation: The final slide invites viewers to join MTI and provides a named contact with WhatsApp and email details.
visual.context: Promotional call to contact a person to join the program.
visual.potential_relevance: The contact invitation is presented as the route to join the same investment and referral program described in the preceding slides.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show that a viewer contacts the listed person, joins, sends funds, or receives any stated benefit.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes depositing Bitcoin for passive daily trading income while tying additional earnings to recruiting members into left and right binary legs. It presents referral bonuses, spillover, multi-level qualification, and increasing deposit amounts as a path to residual income and financial freedom, then directs viewers to contact the promoter to join. The trading-risk disclaimer does not change that the main message is an active solicitation built around recruitment-dependent benefits and investment returns.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 is primary because the presentation describes a multi-person binary hierarchy with left and right legs, spillover, team-depth qualification, and bonuses based on the weaker leg. S03 is supported by the promoted passive and compounded Bitcoin income from a managed trading account, while S02 is supported by the automated trading-software workflow linked to funded accounts.
